description: Raudteeliiklusregister is a dataset listed in Data information gateway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Tarbijakaitse ja Tehnilise Järelevalve Amet. The main function of the national railway traffic register is to keep records of railways and railway vehicles and locomotive drivers, drivers of special railway vehicles and locomotive drivers' licences, safety certificates and safety authorisations. Coverage: Tarbijakaitse ja Tehnilise Järelevalve Amet. The portal shows the English title as "Railroad Register" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Tarbijakaitse ja Tehnilise Järelevalve Amet. The listing shows 2 download or service links in PDF, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-avaandmete-portaal.
